text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

text: The town turns on Luna, and Luna is out. Luna shows the card: officer.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the citizen, Haiku the citizen, Gemma the killer, Sol the killer, Luna the officer, Terra the doctor.

Haiku was voted out on day one after pressing Luna and Sol, and Sonnet was taken in the night. On day two Luna finally claimed officer and named Sol and Gemma as killers, but she had spent the day dodging direct questions, so the claim looked like a desperate move. Gemma turned the room by calling Sol a scapegoat hunter, and Gemma, Sol, and Terra voted Luna out, taking her true claim with her. The killers, Gemma and Sol, were left as the majority of the three survivors and won the game.
